changeSet.comment: Fix records where is_commencement was accidentally nullified during Care Card Follow-Up updates. The timeline query requires is_commencement = false, so NULL values caused historical visits to disappear.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hiv_art_clinical SET is_commencement = false WHERE is_commencement IS NULL AND archived = 0;
